Medical Oncology
Advanced Cancer Care for Dogs and Cats
A cancer diagnosis can be overwhelming, but you don't have to navigate it alone.
At
ARISE Veterinary Specialty & Emergency
, our new Veterinary Oncology service provides advanced cancer diagnosis, treatment, and supportive care for dogs and cats throughout Queen Creek, Gilbert, Chandler, Mesa, and the greater East Valley. Our goal is to deliver personalized treatment plans that help maximize both quality of life and meaningful time with your pet.
Our oncology team combines advanced therapies with compassionate support, helping pet families make informed decisions every step of the way.
Call
(480) 746-6600
to schedule an oncology consultation.
What Is Veterinary Oncology?
Veterinary oncology is the specialty focused on diagnosing and treating cancer in pets. Like human oncology, it centers on individualized treatment plans built around the type of cancer, stage of disease, the patient's overall health, and your family's goals.
At ARISE, we believe cancer treatment should balance effectiveness with comfort. Many pets in treatment keep enjoying their favorite activities, maintain excellent quality of life, and gain valuable time with their families.
Conditions We Commonly Treat
Our Veterinary Oncology service evaluates and treats a wide range of
cancer-related conditions in dogs and cats, including:
Lymphoma
Mast Cell Tumors
Osteosarcoma (Bone Cancer)
Hemangiosarcoma
Melanoma
Soft Tissue Sarcomas
Mammary Tumors
Anal Gland Adenocarcinoma
Transitional Cell Carcinoma (TCC)
Thyroid Tumors
Nasal Tumors
Liver and Splenic Tumors
Brain and Spinal Cord Tumors
Metastatic Cancer
Complex or Undiagnosed Masses
If your pet has recently been diagnosed with cancer or your veterinarian has
concerns about a suspicious mass or abnormal test result, our oncology team
can help determine the next best steps.
Veterinary Cancer Treatment Options
Every patient receives a customized treatment plan designed around their
individual diagnosis and needs.
Chemotherapy
Veterinary chemotherapy protocols are specifically designed to maintain
quality of life while targeting cancer cells. Most pets tolerate
treatment exceptionally well, experiencing far fewer side effects than
human cancer patients.
Targeted Therapies
Targeted cancer treatments work by disrupting specific pathways that
allow cancer cells to grow and spread, providing additional treatment
options for certain tumor types.
Immunotherapy
Immunotherapy harnesses the body's own immune system to recognize and
fight cancer, helping improve outcomes for select patients.
Surgical Oncology Collaboration
For many cancers, surgery plays an important role in treatment. Our
oncology team works closely with ARISE's surgical specialists to
coordinate comprehensive care when surgical intervention is recommended.
Palliative Care & Pain Management
When cure is not possible, our focus shifts to comfort. We provide
treatments aimed at reducing pain, managing symptoms, and helping pets
maintain the highest possible quality of life.

Schedule an In-Person Oncology Consultation
If your pet has been diagnosed with cancer, has a suspicious mass, or you are seeking a second opinion, our oncology team is here to help. Whether you prefer an in-person visit or would like to start with a telemedicine consultation, we can help you understand your options and develop the best plan for your pet.
Call (480) 746-6600
Telemedicine Oncology Consultations
For pet families facing a new cancer diagnosis or seeking guidance about a possible cancer diagnosis, a telemedicine consultation can be a convenient first step. Our oncology team can review your pet's medical history, discuss diagnostic results, explain treatment options, and help you determine the next steps in care.
Please note that telemedicine appointments are consultation visits only. Because a physical examination cannot be performed virtually, an in-person appointment may still be recommended for additional diagnostics, treatment planning, or ongoing care.
